title: 012 runtime
description: 012's own event log (012 --log), via the collector's filelog receiver

panels.title: Recalculation time
panels.description: recalc events: incremental and full recalculations, in milliseconds

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms'])) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms'])) AS p95, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms'])) AS max FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' AND LogAttributes['event'] = 'recalc' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Frame and key-to-frame time (p95 per second)
panels.description: frames summaries: View() time and the time from a key press to its frame; 16 ms is one frame at 60 Hz

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['render_p95_ms'])) AS render_p95, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['key_p95_ms'])) AS key_to_frame_p95, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['key_max_ms'])) AS key_to_frame_max FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' AND LogAttributes['event'] = 'frames' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Heap and cells
panels.description: Live heap (left) and stored cells (right), from the per-second frame summaries

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['heap_bytes'])) AS heap, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cells'])) AS cells FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' AND LogAttributes['event'] = 'frames' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: JEV answer time
panels.description: jev events: request latency and questions still queued when it was sent

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms'])) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms'])) AS p95, max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['queued'])) AS queued FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' AND LogAttributes['event'] = 'jev' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Imports and exports
panels.description: File operations with their sizes and throughput

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, LogAttributes['event'] AS event, LogAttributes['format'] AS format, toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['rows']) AS rows, toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cells']) AS cells, round(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms']), 1) AS ms, round(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['bytes']) / 1048576 / (toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms']) / 1000), 1) AS mb_per_s FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' AND LogAttributes['event'] IN ('import', 'export', 'save', 'open') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Slowest operations
panels.description: The 25 slowest spans in the range: recalcs, commands, sorts, finds, imports

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, LogAttributes['event'] AS event, LogAttributes['id'] AS command, round(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['dur_ms']), 2) AS ms, toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['evaluated']) AS evaluated, toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cells']) AS cells FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' AND LogAttributes['event'] NOT IN ('frames', 'start', 'frame') ORDER BY ms DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Events per minute
panels.description: What 012 has been doing, by event type

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, LogAttributes['event'] AS event, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = '012' GROUP BY time, event ORDER BY time
